semantic_fixtures.covers: Real seven-mana cast and entry produce five counters before state-based actions, with derived 5/5 stats.

An additional counter of any provenance pays with one mana before resolution; stun counters are excluded. Wrong actor, missing mana and stale counter-source incarnation reject atomically. Exactly one colorless 1/1 flying artifact creature Pentavite token is created, then can be sacrificed as a cost before a counter is placed.

A real non-token creature with current Pentavite subtype qualifies. Wrong subtype, opponent-controlled Pentavite, wrong actor and missing mana reject atomically. Mana and the sacrifice precede counter placement.

A surviving zero-plus-counter source cannot pay with stun counters and has an unpayable offer. Removing its final plus counter from its printed 0/0 sends it to the graveyard while the independent paid ability still creates its token.
